exitCriteria.title: Professional bilingual review is complete
exitCriteria.reason: English/French route parity and draft copy are automated, but no professional, subject-matter bilingual review record exists.

exitCriteria.title: An external accessibility audit is complete
exitCriteria.reason: The repository has a source-level accessibility gate only; it explicitly does not claim an independent WCAG 2.2 AA or EN 301 549 audit.

exitCriteria.title: A security review is complete
exitCriteria.reason: No production threat-model, security-review, or sign-off evidence is present.

exitCriteria.title: Load testing is complete
exitCriteria.reason: Artifact budgets do not measure a deployed service or establish the required 50× load-test result.

exitCriteria.title: Reproducibility from the raw archive is demonstrated
exitCriteria.reason: A read-only, version-pinned restoration of three immutable raw snapshots recorded byte length, SHA-256, ZIP integrity, and temporary-copy removal, but no complete admitted output has been reproduced from its raw archived inputs. The drill is restoration evidence only.

exitCriteria.title: Legal, licence, and attribution review is complete
exitCriteria.reason: Individual source records may carry attribution evidence, but no legal review or complete production-release licence and attribution sign-off exists.

exitCriteria.title: Governance and corrections procedures are implemented
exitCriteria.reason: The bilingual correction policy and validation tests define classifications, service targets, accountable-recipient and public-record requirements without claiming a live intake or real cases.

exitCriteria.title: An operations handbook is complete
exitCriteria.reason: The stated reason for this failure is no longer true. docs/OPERATIONS_HANDBOOK.md now carries all four sections this criterion names: ownership in section 2, incident response in section 3, escalation in section 4, and production procedures in section 6, written against ChatGPT Sites as the actual host. The rollback procedure in section 6.2 is actionable end to end without any host knowledge, since the unit of rollback is a Git commit and the mechanism is another deploy. The handbook declares thirteen gaps of its own, and each operational one is separately gated: G1 is the on-call-rota criterion, G3 is observability, G9 is backups. Holding this criterion on those absences would count the same gap three times and leave a documentation gate that no amount of documentation could close. It nevertheless stays fail, because the handbook's own section 2.2 assigns the question of whether a criterion may flip to the Release approver role, which resolves to the accountable owner and not to engineering. Flipping this gate on the authority of a document that says engineering may not flip it would contradict the evidence being bound. The external blocker production-operations also names the handbook alongside the rota, monitoring, backups and escalation as things an accountable operational owner must establish, and unbundling that is the owner's call. The case for a pass is complete and recorded here so it can be acted on in a single edit; what is missing is a decision, not more work.

exitCriteria.title: An on-call rota is complete
exitCriteria.reason: No staffed, approved on-call rota or escalation coverage is recorded.

exitCriteria.title: Bulk downloads are complete
exitCriteria.reason: Only immutable illustrative-download contracts exist; no real CSV or GeoPackage binary has been retrieved or published.

exitCriteria.title: A citation format is implemented
exitCriteria.reason: Release downloads require provenance metadata and generate a stable citation containing the release, time range, boundary edition, method, retrieval date, and artifact URL.

exitCriteria.title: Release notes are implemented
exitCriteria.reason: The release manifest requires a bilingual note, immutable artifact checksums, licence IDs, boundary edition, method version, corrections URL, and stale/degraded state; tests reject missing notes.

exitCriteria.title: Observability is complete
exitCriteria.reason: No deployed monitoring, alerting, log-retention, dashboard, or operational review evidence is recorded.

exitCriteria.title: Backups are complete
exitCriteria.reason: The immutable-storage record explicitly says that no Canadian recovery copy or documented provider durability/recovery evidence exists.

exitCriteria.title: Restore tests are complete
exitCriteria.reason: The exact immutable versions of three raw archives were restored, verified, and removed from controlled temporary storage in a recorded read-only drill.

exitCriteria.title: CDN and tile validation are complete
exitCriteria.reason: No production CDN, admitted tiles, or live tile-validation evidence is recorded; the source-level artifact budget is not a substitute.

externalBlockers.reason: A qualified reviewer must complete and record bilingual subject-matter review.
An independent WCAG 2.2 AA and EN 301 549 audit is required.
Production security review and measured 50× load-test evidence need an approved deployment environment.
Counsel and rights holders must approve the complete production release, licence, attribution, terms, privacy, and disclaimer materials.
An accountable operational owner must establish the handbook, on-call rota, monitoring, backups, and escalation procedures.
Admitted real figures, bulk artifacts, CDN/tile deployment, and live validation are required before production delivery can open.

nonProductionBoundary: The existing public site remains a technical preview with illustrative data. This record does not claim a production deployment, production figure, reviewed translation, accessibility conformance, security review, load result, backup, live operations, bulk download, CDN, or tile validation.
